task_contract.instructions: Group source by period and unit_id. Sum gross_cny, refund_cny and cost_cny. revenue_cny = summed gross_cny minus summed refund_cny; profit_cny = revenue_cny minus summed cost_cny. The published v1 binding maps net_revenue_cny to gross_cny and refund_cny to zero; v2 deducts refunds exactly once. Join baseline by unit_id; difference = current revenue_cny minus baseline_value. Retain current-period base quantities and baseline_period. This is a count/amount change, not a rate or growth ranking. Return exactly output_schema, sorted ascending by period then unit_id. No ratios, risk thresholds, ranking or causal inference.
